Setting the temperature to 0 forces greedy decoding, so the model selects the most probable next token every time and produces deterministic, stable outputs.
Setting the temperature to 1 keeps full randomness, which is the opposite of deterministic. Adding an instruction like make your response deterministic at the start or end of the prompt does not control the sampling process and will not reliably make output deterministic.

zh.question: 一家公司正在其應用程式中添加大型語言模型 (LLM)，並且需要盡可能確定性和穩定的回應。哪種解決方案可以滿足這個要求？

options.A: 在發送之前將“使您的回應具有確定性”添加到提示末尾
options.B: 提交提示時將溫度參數設定為1
options.C: 提交提示時將溫度參數設定為0
options.D: 在發送之前將“使您的回應具有確定性”添加到提示的開頭

zh.explanation:
將溫度設為 0 會強制進行貪婪解碼，因此模型每次都會選擇最有可能的下一個標記，並產生確定性、穩定的輸出。
將溫度設定為 1 可保持完全隨機性，這與確定性相反。在提示的開始或結束處添加諸如使響應具有確定性之類的指令不會控制採樣過程，也不會可靠地使輸出具有確定性。

question: Which large language model (LLM) parameter sets how many candidate next tokens the model considers at each generation step?
explanation:
The Top K parameter limits sampling at each step to the K most probable next tokens, so it directly controls how many candidate tokens the model considers when generating each token.
Maximum tokens caps the total length of the output, not the candidate pool at each step. Temperature adjusts the randomness of the distribution rather than the number of candidates. Batch size concerns how many inputs are processed together, not token selection.

zh.question: 哪個大型語言模型 (LLM) 參數設定模型在每個生成步驟中考慮多少個候選下一個標記？
zh.explanation:
Top K 參數將每一步的取樣限制為 K 個最可能的下一個標記，因此它直接控制模型在產生每個標記時考慮多少個候選標記。
最大令牌限制了輸出的總長度，而不是每個步驟的候選池。溫度調整的是分佈的隨機性，而不是候選者的數量。批次大小涉及一起處理多少輸入，而不是令牌選擇。

question: An AI practitioner wants a large language model (LLM) to produce more diverse and creative output. How should the practitioner adjust an inference parameter?
explanation:
Raising the temperature flattens the model's probability distribution and increases the chance of selecting less-likely tokens, which produces more varied and creative responses.
Decreasing the Top K value narrows the candidate tokens and makes output more focused, not more diverse. Increasing the response length only makes output longer. Decreasing the prompt length reduces context and does not increase creativity.

zh.question: 人工智慧從業者想要一個大型語言模型（LLM）來產生更多樣化和創造性的輸出。實踐者應該如何調整推理參數？
zh.explanation:
升高溫度會使模型的機率分佈變得平坦，並增加選擇不太可能的標記的機會，從而產生更多樣化和創造性的反應。
降低 Top K 值會縮小候選標記的範圍，並使輸出更加集中，而不是更加多樣化。增加響應長度只會使輸出更長。縮短提示長度會減少上下文，並且不會增加創造力。

question: A company will fine-tune a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock to refine the style of its app's output messages. Which type of data does the company need?

options.B: Paired samples of input messages and their corresponding output messages
options.D: Separate, unpaired samples of input messages and output messages

explanation:
Fine-tuning to refine output style requires paired examples of input messages and their corresponding output messages, so the model learns the mapping from input to the desired styled output.
Samples of only input messages or only output messages lack the input-to-output relationship the model must learn. Separate, unpaired samples do not show which output goes with which input, so the model cannot learn the styling.

zh.question: 一家公司將在 Amazon Bedrock 上微調大型語言模型 (LLM)，以改善其應用程式輸出訊息的風格。公司需要哪種類型的資料？

options.B: 輸入訊息及其對應輸出訊息的配對樣本
options.D: 輸入訊息和輸出訊息的單獨的、不成對的樣本

zh.explanation:
微調以完善輸出樣式需要輸入訊息及其對應輸出訊息的配對範例，以便模型學習從輸入到所需樣式輸出的對應。
僅輸入訊息或僅輸出訊息的樣本缺乏模型必須學習的輸入到輸出關係。單獨的、未配對的樣本不會顯示哪個輸出與哪個輸入對應，因此模型無法學習樣式。

question: Which two parameters are commonly used to control the diversity of a generative AI model's output?
explanation:
Top-k sampling limits selection to the k most likely next tokens, and Top-p (nucleus) sampling selects from the smallest set of tokens whose probabilities sum to p; both adjust the candidate pool to balance diversity and quality of generated text.
Model size, training dataset size, and hardware configuration affect a model's capability, cost, or speed, but they are not runtime parameters that control output diversity.

zh.question: 哪兩個參數通常用來控制產生人工智慧模型輸出的多樣性？
zh.explanation:
Top-k 採樣將選擇限制為 k 個最有可能的下一個標記，而 Top-p（核心）採樣從概率總和為 p 的最小標記集中進行選擇；兩者都調整候選池以平衡生成文本的多樣性和質量。
模型大小、訓練資料集大小和硬體配置會影響模型的能力、成本或速度，但它們不是控制輸出多樣性的運行時參數。

question: A design team uses an image-generation foundation model (FM) on Amazon Bedrock and wants to control how detailed or abstract each generated image is. Which model parameter should they adjust?
explanation:
The generation step parameter sets how many refinement steps the model runs while creating an image; more steps yield more detailed images and fewer steps yield more abstract ones, so it controls the level of detail.
A model checkpoint selects a saved version of the model, not the detail of a single image. Batch size sets how many images are produced at once. Token length applies to text generation, not image detail.

zh.question: 設計團隊在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用影像產生基礎模型 (FM)，並希望控制每個生成影像的詳細或抽象程度。他們應該調整哪個模型參數？
zh.explanation:
生成步驟參數設定模型在創建圖像時運行多少個細化步驟；更多的步驟產生更詳細的圖像，更少的步驟產生更抽象的圖像，因此它控制細節的水平。
模型檢查點選擇模型的保存版本，而不是單一影像的細節。批次大小設定一次產生多少圖像。令牌長度適用於文字生成，不適用於影像細節。

question: A team generates images with an Amazon Nova Canvas model and needs to keep specific items out of the results. Which solution meets this requirement?
explanation:
A negative prompt specifies the items or characteristics the model should avoid, so it keeps the unwanted items out of the generated images.
A higher temperature only adds randomness. A more detailed prompt describes what to include but does not reliably exclude specific items. Switching to another foundation model does not provide a mechanism to exclude items.

zh.question: 團隊使用 Amazon Nova Canvas 模型產生影像，並且需要將特定項目排除在結果之外。哪種解決方案可以滿足這個要求？

options.D: 切換到另一個基礎模型（FM）

zh.explanation:
否定提示指定模型應避免的項目或特徵，因此它將不需要的項目排除在生成的圖像之外。
更高的溫度只會增加隨機性。更詳細的提示描述了要包含的內容，但不能可靠地排除特定項目。切換到另一個基礎模型不提供排除項目的機制。

question: A company is building a generative AI tool and will customize a foundation model (FM) with its internal documents. Which approach meets this requirement?
explanation:
Continued pre-training further trains a foundation model on the company's internal documents, so the model adapts to the company's domain and content.
Classification and regression are supervised ML tasks, not ways to customize an FM on documents. Distillation transfers knowledge from a larger model to a smaller one rather than adapting a model to internal documents.

zh.question: 一家公司正在建立生成式 AI 工具，並將利用其內部文件自訂基礎模型 (FM)。哪一種方法可以滿足這個要求？
zh.explanation:
持續的預訓練進一步在公司內部文件上訓練基礎模型，使模型適應公司的領域和內容。
分類和回歸是有監督的 ML 任務，而不是在文件上自訂 FM 的方法。蒸餾將知識從較大的模型轉移到較小的模型，而不是使模型適應內部文件。

question: A research group wants several scientists to manually compare the outputs of different generative AI models for a defined prompt. Which solution meets this requirement?

options.A: Use automatic evaluation on Amazon Personalize
options.B: Use model evaluation on Amazon Bedrock
options.C: Use content moderation on Amazon Rekognition
options.D: Use sentiment analysis on Amazon Comprehend

explanation:
Amazon Bedrock model evaluation supports human-based evaluation, so a team of scientists can review and compare the models' outputs against the group's prompt and criteria.
Amazon Personalize provides recommendations. Amazon Rekognition does image and video content moderation. Amazon Comprehend does NLP tasks such as sentiment analysis. None of these provides human evaluation of generative model output.

zh.question: 一個研究小組希望幾位科學家手動比較不同生成式人工智慧模型的輸出，以獲得明確的提示。哪種解決方案可以滿足這個要求？

options.A: 對 Amazon Personalize 使用自動評估
options.B: 對 Amazon Bedrock 使用模型評估
options.C: 對 Amazon Rekognition 使用內容審核
options.D: 對 Amazon Comprehend 使用情緒分析

zh.explanation:
Amazon Bedrock 模型評估支援基於人的評估，因此科學家團隊可以根據小組的提示和標準審查和比較模型的輸出。
Amazon Personalize 提供建議。 Amazon Rekognition 進行影像和視訊內容審核。 Amazon Comprehend 執行情緒分析等 NLP 任務。這些都不能提供對生成模型輸出的人類評估。

question: A support center rolls out a large language model (LLM) chatbot to cut down how many steps agents take when answering customer questions. Which business metric best shows whether the chatbot is making a difference?
explanation:
Average call duration directly reflects how much the chatbot reduces the steps agents take to resolve questions, so tracking it measures the chatbot's business impact.
Corporate social responsibility and regulatory compliance are organizational concerns unrelated to how quickly agents resolve customer questions. Website engagement rate measures online visitor behavior, not call center efficiency.

zh.question: 支援中心推出了大型語言模型 (LLM) 聊天機器人，以減少客服人員在回答客戶問題時採取的步驟。哪個業務指標最能顯示聊天機器人是否發揮了作用？
zh.explanation:
平均通話時間直接反映了聊天機器人減少了客服人員解決問題的步驟的程度，因此追蹤它可以衡量聊天機器人的業務影響。
企業社會責任和法規遵循是組織關注的問題，與客服人員解決客戶問題的速度無關。網站參與率衡量的是線上訪客的行為，而不是呼叫中心的效率。

question: For AI workloads, what is the main benefit of pairing Amazon Aurora with the pgvector extension?

options.C: It enables vector similarity search inside a relational database

explanation:
Amazon Aurora with the pgvector extension enables vector similarity search inside a relational database, so embeddings can be stored alongside structured data and queried with SQL while keeping relational features.
Aurora does not automatically generate AI models or provide pre-trained language models. Serverless capacity is a deployment option but is not the primary advantage of pgvector for AI applications.

zh.question: 對於 AI 工作負載，將 Amazon Aurora 與 pgvector 擴充配對的主要好處是什麼？

options.B: 它提供預先訓練的語言模型
options.C: 它支援在關聯式資料庫內進行向量相似性搜尋
options.D: 它提供無伺服器運算能力

zh.explanation:
具有 pgvector 擴展的 Amazon Aurora 可以在關聯式資料庫內進行向量相似性搜索，因此嵌入可以與結構化資料一起儲存並使用 SQL 進行查詢，同時保留關係特徵。
Aurora 不會自動產生 AI 模型或提供預先訓練的語言模型。無伺服器容量是一種部署選項，但並不是 pgvector 對於 AI 應用程式的主要優勢。

question: A company runs several generative AI applications on Amazon Bedrock and wants to version its prompts, compare different prompt variants, and roll back to a previous version if quality drops. Which Amazon Bedrock feature meets these requirements?
explanation:
Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management lets teams create, version, and manage prompt templates, compare variants, and roll back to earlier versions, providing the lifecycle controls the company needs to maintain prompt quality across its applications.
Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases index and retrieve documents for RAG workflows. Amazon Bedrock Guardrails filter harmful or unwanted content. Amazon Bedrock Model Evaluation scores and compares model performance. None of these manages prompt versions or supports rollback.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上運行多個生成式 AI 應用程式，並希望對其提示進行版本控制、比較不同的提示變體，並在質量下降時回滾到之前的版本。哪一個 Amazon Bedrock 功能滿足這些要求？
zh.explanation:
Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 允許團隊建立、版本化和管理提示範本、比較變體以及回滾到早期版本，從而提供公司維持其應用程式中的提示品質所需的生命週期控制。
Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 索引和檢索 RAG 工作流程的文件。 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 過濾有害或不需要的內容。 Amazon Bedrock Model Evaluation 評分並比較模型表現。這些都不管理提示版本或支援回滾。

question: A company deployed an AI assistant on Amazon Bedrock to handle customer service requests. It wants to measure how effectively the assistant resolves customer issues without escalation. Which metric best captures this?
explanation:
Task completion rate measures the percentage of customer requests the assistant fully resolves without needing human escalation, directly reflecting how effectively it meets the business objective of handling service requests autonomously.
BLEU score measures translation quality by comparing generated text to references. Perplexity measures how well a language model predicts text. Model parameter count describes model size. None of these measures whether the assistant successfully completes customer tasks.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上部署了人工智慧助理來處理客戶服務請求。它希望衡量助理在不升級的情況下解決客戶問題的效率。哪個指標最能反映這一點？
zh.explanation:
任務完成率衡量助理在無需人工升級的情況下完全解決的客戶請求的百分比，直接反映其如何有效地滿足自主處理服務請求的業務目標。
BLEU 分數透過將產生的文本與參考文獻進行比較來衡量翻譯品質。困惑度衡量語言模型預測文本的能力。模型參數計數描述了模型大小。這些都無法衡量助理是否成功完成客戶任務。

question: Which two metrics are examples of business-alignment metrics for evaluating AI applications?
explanation:
User satisfaction measures how well the AI application meets end-user expectations, and cost per interaction measures the operational expense of each user engagement, both of which directly align with business objectives and are defined as business-alignment metrics for AI applications.
BERTScore and ROUGE score are technical metrics that measure the quality of generated text against references rather than business outcomes. Model training time is an operational metric about how long training takes and says nothing about whether the application achieves its business goals.

zh.question: 哪兩個指標是用於評估人工智慧應用程式的業務一致性指標的範例？
zh.explanation:
使用者滿意度衡量人工智慧應用程式滿足最終使用者期望的程度，每次互動成本衡量每次使用者參與的營運費用，這兩者都與業務目標直接相關，並被定義為人工智慧應用程式的業務一致性指標。
BERTcore 和 ROUGE 分數是根據參考而非業務成果來衡量產生文字品質的技術指標。模型訓練時間是一個關於訓練需要多長時間的操作指標，並沒有說明應用程式是否實現其業務目標。

question: A company is building a knowledge graph that also needs to store vector embeddings and run similarity searches over them alongside graph traversals. Which AWS database service supports both graph queries and vector search?
explanation:
Amazon Neptune is a graph database that also supports vector similarity search, allowing the company to store embeddings alongside knowledge graph relationships and run both graph traversals and nearest-neighbor queries in the same database.
Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value and document database without native graph or vector search capabilities. Amazon Redshift is a data warehouse for analytics. Amazon ElastiCache is an in-memory caching service. None of these combines graph queries with vector similarity search.

zh.question: 一家公司正在建立一個知識圖，該知識圖還需要儲存向量嵌入並在圖遍歷的同時對其進行相似性搜尋。哪一種 AWS 資料庫服務同時支援圖形查詢和向量搜尋？
zh.explanation:
Amazon Neptune 是一個圖形資料庫，還支援向量相似性搜索，允許公司將嵌入與知識圖關係一起存儲，並在同一資料庫中運行圖遍歷和最近鄰查詢。
Amazon DynamoDB 是一個鍵值和文件資料庫，沒有本機圖形或向量搜尋功能。 Amazon Redshift 是一個用於分析的資料倉儲。 Amazon ElastiCache 是一項記憶體快取服務。這些都沒有將圖查詢與向量相似性搜尋結合。

question: A company generates long-form marketing content with a foundation model and wants to evaluate quality at scale without relying on human reviewers. Which evaluation approach uses another large language model to score the outputs?
explanation:
LLM-as-a-judge uses a separate large language model to evaluate and score the outputs of another model against defined criteria, providing scalable quality assessment without requiring human reviewers for every output.
BLEU scoring compares generated text to reference translations using n-gram overlap and requires pre-written references. Benchmark dataset comparison evaluates against fixed test sets with known answers. A/B testing requires live users to compare variants. None of these uses another LLM to judge output quality.

zh.question: 一家公司使用基礎模型產生長篇行銷內容，並希望在不依賴人工審核員的情況下大規模評估品質。哪種評估方法使用另一個大型語言模型來對輸出進行評分？

options.D: 與真實使用者進行 A/B 測試

zh.explanation:
LLM-as-a-judge 使用單獨的大型語言模型根據定義的標準對另一個模型的輸出進行評估和評分，提供可擴展的品質評估，而無需對每個輸出進行人工審核。
BLEU 評分使用 n 元語法重疊將產生的文字與參考翻譯進行比較，並且需要預先編寫的參考。基準資料集比較根據已知答案的固定測試集進行評估。 A/B 測試需要即時使用者比較變體。這些都沒有使用另一個法學碩士來判斷輸出品質。

question: A company deployed a RAG-based customer support assistant and wants to evaluate whether the retrieval component returns relevant documents for user queries. Which approach should the team use?

options.A: Measure the model's perplexity on a held-out dataset
options.B: Compare retrieved passages against known-correct source documents for a set of test queries
options.C: Count the total number of API calls made to Amazon Bedrock
options.D: Measure the BLEU score of the model's outputs

explanation:
Evaluating a RAG application requires assessing whether the retrieval component returns relevant documents, which is done by comparing retrieved passages for test queries against known-correct source documents and measuring retrieval precision and recall.
Perplexity evaluates language model quality, not retrieval relevance. Counting API calls measures usage volume. BLEU score evaluates translation quality. None of these assesses the retrieval pipeline.

zh.question: 一家公司部署了基於 RAG 的客戶支援助理，並希望評估檢索元件是否傳回使用者查詢的相關文件。團隊應該使用哪種方法？

options.A: 測量模型在保留資料集上的困惑度
options.B: 將檢索到的段落與已知正確的來源文件進行比較，以進行一組測試查詢
options.C: 計算對 Amazon Bedrock 進行的 API 呼叫總數
options.D: 測量模型輸出的 BLEU 分數

zh.explanation:
評估 RAG 應用程式需要評估檢索組件是否返回相關文檔，這是透過將測試查詢的檢索段落與已知正確的來源文檔進行比較並測量檢索精度和召回率來完成的。
困惑度評估語言模型的質量，而不是檢索相關性。對 API 呼叫進行計數可以衡量使用量。 BLEU 分數評估翻譯品質。這些都沒有評估檢索管道。

question: A company sends the same lengthy system prompt thousands of times daily with only the user query changing, and it wants to reduce latency and cost. Which FM selection criterion is most relevant?
explanation:
Prompt caching stores the processed representation of a repeated system prompt so the model does not re-process it on every request, reducing both latency and cost when the same prefix is sent repeatedly with only the user query varying.
Multilingual support concerns language coverage. Model complexity relates to reasoning capability. Diffusion capability applies to image generation models. None of these addresses the cost of processing a repeated prompt prefix.

zh.question: 一家公司每天發送數千次相同的冗長系統提示，只有使用者查詢發生變化，並且它希望減少延遲和成本。哪一個 FM 選擇標準最相關？
zh.explanation:
提示快取儲存重複系統提示的處理表示，因此模型不會在每個請求上重新處理它，從而在重複發送相同前綴而僅使用者查詢發生變化時減少延遲和成本。
多語言支援涉及語言覆蓋範圍。模型複雜度與推理能力有關。擴散能力適用於影像生成模型。這些都沒有解決處理重複提示前綴的成本。

question: A company needs a foundation model that can accept both text and images as input and produce text output. Which FM selection criterion determines whether a model supports this?
explanation:
Modality describes the types of input and output a model supports, such as text, images, audio, or video. A model must support multimodal input (text and images) to accept both types and produce text output.
Temperature range controls output randomness. Context window size determines how much information fits in a single prompt. Training dataset size affects model knowledge but does not determine supported input types.

zh.question: 公司需要一個可以接受文字和圖像作為輸入並產生文字輸出的基礎模型。哪個 FM 選擇標準決定模型是否支援此功能？
zh.explanation:
模態描述模型支援的輸入和輸出類型，例如文字、圖像、音訊或視訊。模型必須支援多模式輸入（文字和圖像）才能接受這兩種類型並產生文字輸出。
溫度範圍控制輸出隨機性。上下文視窗大小決定單一提示中可以容納多少資訊。訓練資料集大小會影響模型知識，但不會決定支援的輸入類型。

question: A company runs a large foundation model on Amazon Bedrock but finds the inference cost too high. It wants a smaller, cheaper model that retains most of the large model's quality. Which customization approach meets this requirement?
explanation:
Model distillation trains a smaller student model to replicate the behavior of a larger teacher model, producing a compact model that retains most of the original's quality at lower inference cost.
RAG retrieves external documents at query time but does not reduce model size or cost. Continuous pre-training updates knowledge but does not shrink the model. In-context learning adds examples to the prompt, which actually increases token costs.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上運行大型基礎模型，但發現推理成本太高。它想要一種更小、更便宜的型號，同時保留大型型號的大部分品質。哪種客製化方法可以滿足此要求？
zh.explanation:
模型蒸餾訓練較小的學生模型來複製較大教師模型的行為，從而產生一個緊湊的模型，該模型以較低的推理成本保留了大部分原始質量。
RAG 在查詢時檢索外部文檔，但不會減少模型大小或成本。持續的預訓練會更新知識，但不會縮小模型。上下文學習在提示中添加了範例，這實際上增加了令牌成本。

question: A travel company wants an AI system that can search flight availability, compare prices across airlines, book tickets, and send confirmation emails, all from a single customer request. Which solution meets this requirement?

options.B: An AI agent that orchestrates multi-step tasks using tool calls
options.C: A classification model that routes requests to departments
options.D: A recommendation engine that suggests popular flights

explanation:
An AI agent can break down the customer's request into steps (searching flights, comparing prices, booking, and sending confirmation) and execute each by calling the appropriate tools and APIs, which is the defining capability of agents for complex business workflows.
A summarization model condenses text but cannot take actions. A classification model routes requests but cannot execute multi-step tasks. A recommendation engine suggests items but cannot book flights or send emails.

zh.question: 一家旅遊公司想要一個人工智慧系統，可以搜尋航班可用性、比較各航空公司的價格、預訂機票並發送確認電子郵件，所有這些都可以根據單一客戶的請求進行。哪種解決方案可以滿足這個要求？

options.B: 使用工具呼叫編排多步驟任務的 AI 代理
options.C: 將請求路由到部門的分類模型
options.D: 推薦熱門航班的推薦引擎

zh.explanation:
人工智慧代理可以將客戶的請求分解為多個步驟（搜尋航班、比較價格、預訂和發送確認），並透過呼叫適當的工具和 API 來執行每個步驟，這是代理複雜業務工作流程的定義能力。
摘要模型會壓縮文本，但無法執行操作。分類模型路由請求，但無法執行多步驟任務。推薦引擎可以推薦商品，但無法預訂航班或發送電子郵件。

question: Which two practices improve the quality of responses from a foundation model through prompt engineering?

options.A: Be specific and concise in instructions
options.B: Use vague language to allow creative freedom
options.C: Experiment with different prompt structures and iterate
options.D: Always use the maximum token limit for prompts
options.E: Avoid providing any context to keep prompts short

explanation:
Being specific and concise tells the model exactly what is expected without ambiguity, and experimenting with different prompt structures and iterating helps discover what works best for each task, both of which are prompt engineering best practices.
Vague language introduces ambiguity that degrades response quality. Using the maximum token limit wastes tokens on irrelevant content. Avoiding context deprives the model of information it needs to respond accurately.

zh.question: 哪兩種實踐可以透過即時工程來提高基礎模型的回應品質？

options.B: 使用模糊的語言來允許創作自由
options.C: 嘗試不同的提示結構並迭代
options.D: 始終使用提示的最大令牌限制
options.E: 避免提供任何上下文以使提示簡短

zh.explanation:
具體和簡潔可以明確地告訴模型預期的內容，並且嘗試不同的提示結構和迭代有助於發現最適合每個任務的方法，這兩者都是提示工程最佳實踐。
含糊的語言會產生歧義，從而降低迴應品質。使用最大令牌限制會在不相關的內容上浪費令牌。避免上下文會剝奪模型準確回應所需的資訊。

question: A team manages dozens of prompts across multiple generative AI applications and wants to track changes, compare variants, and revert to previous versions if quality drops. Which Amazon Bedrock feature meets this requirement?
explanation:
Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management provides prompt versioning, variant comparison, and rollback capabilities, giving teams lifecycle control over their prompts across multiple applications.
Knowledge Bases index and retrieve documents for RAG. Guardrails filter content for safety. Model Evaluation scores model performance. None of these manages prompt versions.

zh.question: 一個團隊管理多個生成式 AI 應用程式中的數十個提示，並希望追蹤變更、比較變體，並在品質下降時恢復到先前的版本。哪一個 Amazon Bedrock 功能滿足此要求？
zh.explanation:
Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management 提供提示版本控制、變體比較和回滾功能，使團隊能夠跨多個應用程式對其提示進行生命週期控制。
知識庫索引和檢索 RAG 文件。護欄過濾內容以確保安全。模型評估對模型性能進行評分。這些都不管理提示版本。

question: A team is using Amazon Bedrock to customize a foundation model with their own labeled data so it performs better on a domain-specific support task. Arrange the steps of the fine-tuning workflow from first to last.

options.A: Run the fine-tuning job, which adjusts the model weights on the provided examples
options.B: Select a base foundation model that supports customization for the target task
options.C: Provision throughput for the resulting custom model and deploy it for inference
options.D: Prepare and upload a labeled training dataset to Amazon S3 in the required format
options.E: Evaluate the tuned model against a held-out validation set to confirm it improved

explanation:
You must first select a base foundation model that supports customization, then prepare and upload a labeled dataset to S3, because the training job needs both a target model and formatted data before it can start. Running the fine-tuning job adjusts the weights, after which you evaluate the tuned model on a held-out set and, only once it passes, provision throughput to deploy it.
A common mistake is to evaluate before training or to deploy before evaluating, but you cannot measure a tuned model that does not yet exist, and shipping an unevaluated model risks regressions. Data preparation also precedes the job itself, since fine-tuning consumes the labeled examples rather than producing them.

zh.question: 一個團隊正在使用 Amazon Bedrock 使用自己的標記資料自訂基礎模型，以便它在特定於網域的支援任務上表現更好。從頭到尾安排微調工作流程的步驟。

options.A: 執行微調作業，調整提供的範例的模型權重
options.B: 選擇支援目標任務定制的基礎模型
options.C: 為生成的自訂模型配置吞吐量並將其部署用於推理
options.D: 以所需格式準備並上傳標籤的訓練資料集至 Amazon S3
options.E: 根據保留的驗證集評估調整後的模型，以確認其已改進

zh.explanation:
您必須先選擇支援自訂的基礎模型，然後準備標記資料集並將其上傳到S3，因為訓練作業在開始之前需要目標模型和格式化資料。執行微調作業會調整權重，然後在保留的集合上評估調整後的模型，並且只有在通過後，才配置吞吐量來部署它。
一個常見的錯誤是在訓練之前進行評估或在評估之前進行部署，但是您無法測量尚不存在的調整後的模型，並且交付未評估的模型存在回歸風險。資料準備也先於作業本身，因為微調會消耗標記的範例而不是產生它們。

question: Match each foundation model evaluation metric to what it primarily measures. Pair each metric on the left with the correct description on the right.

targets.1: Precision of n-gram overlap between generated text and references, used mainly to score machine translation quality
targets.2: How well a language model predicts a sample, measured as its uncertainty over the next token, where a lower value is better
targets.3: Recall-oriented overlap of n-grams between generated and reference text, used mainly to score summarization quality
targets.4: Semantic similarity between generated and reference text computed from contextual embeddings rather than exact token matches

explanation:
ROUGE is recall-oriented and is the standard choice for summarization, while BLEU emphasizes n-gram precision against references and is the classic machine translation metric, so these two are easy to swap if you only remember that both use n-gram overlap. BERTScore moves beyond exact token matching by comparing contextual embeddings to capture semantic similarity, and perplexity is an intrinsic measure of how confidently a model predicts the next token, where lower is better.
The key distinction is overlap-based metrics (ROUGE and BLEU) versus an embedding-based one (BERTScore) versus an intrinsic probability measure (perplexity). A tempting error is to assume a higher perplexity signals a better model, but perplexity reflects uncertainty, so lower values indicate stronger next-token prediction.

zh.question: 將每個基礎模型評估指標與其主要衡量的內容相匹配。將左側的每個指標與右側的正確描述配對。
zh.explanation:
ROUGE 是以召回為導向的，是摘要的標準選擇，而 BLEU 則強調針對參考文獻的 n-gram 精度，是經典的機器翻譯指標，因此如果您只記得兩者都使用 n-gram 重疊，那麼這兩者很容易互換。 BERTScore 透過比較上下文嵌入來捕捉語義相似性，超越了精確的標記匹配，而困惑度是模型預測下一個標記的信心程度的內在衡量標準，其中越低越好。
關鍵區別是基於重疊的度量（ROUGE 和 BLEU）與基於嵌入的度量（BERTScore）與內在機率測量（困惑度）。一個誘人的錯誤是假設較高的困惑度表示更好的模型，但困惑度反映了不確定性，因此較低的值表示更強的下一個令牌預測。

targets.1: 生成文本和參考文獻之間的 n 元語法重疊精度，主要用於對機器翻譯品質進行評分
targets.2: 語言模型預測樣本的效果如何，以它對下一個標記的不確定性來衡量，其中值越低越好
targets.3: 生成文字和參考文本之間 n 元語法的面向回憶的重疊，主要用於對摘要品質進行評分
targets.4: 生成文本和參考文本之間的語義相似性是根據上下文嵌入而不是精確的標記匹配計算得出的
